summary: Fills a 3x3 rotation matrix (nine float components at this+0 through this+0x20) from two Euler-angle arguments a2 and a3: it computes the sine and cosine of each angle and writes the eight nonzero entries of the standard rotation matrix, with the middle entry this[5] forced to zero.

operations.description: Computes sin(a2), cos(a2), sin(a3) and cos(a3) from the two Euler-angle arguments.
Writes the first row of the rotation matrix: this[0] = cos(a3)*cos(a2), this[1] = -(sin(a3)*cos(a2)), this[2] = sin(a2).
Writes the second row of the rotation matrix: this[3] = sin(a3), this[4] = cos(a3), this[5] = 0.0.
Writes the third row of the rotation matrix: this[6] = -(cos(a3)*sin(a2)), this[7] = sin(a3)*sin(a2), this[8] = cos(a2).
